India's finance leaders call for stronger banks and tougher market rules

SEBI chief and PK Mishra said India's financing needs for infrastructure, manufacturing, urbanisation, energy transition, MSMEs and technology cannot be met by banks alone. They called for stronger banks, deeper capital markets and tougher SEBI regulations to make markets safer and attract more investors.
